subject.title: [Bug]: room_event forces message_tool_only despite visibleReplies=automatic, destabilizing prompt cache

question: Should ambient room_event runs use a session-stable prompt/tool contract, including the safe non-owner owner-only Gateway tool inventory for every sender, while effective visible delivery remains message-tool-only?
rationale: The source-level cache problem is clear, but changing owner-sent room_event tool visibility sits on a product and security-boundary policy line that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Accept Prompt-Stable Room Events
options.body: Land the linked candidate after confirming that ambient room events should use the safe non-owner owner-only inventory and separated prompt-facing delivery mode.

options.title: Preserve Owner Room-Event Tools
options.body: Require a revision that keeps owner-only tools visible for owner-sent room events and either proves cache stability or accepts the remaining split.

options.title: Document Strict Behavior Only
options.body: Reject the runtime change and document the prompt-cache and visibility tradeoff as part of the strict ambient-room contract.

recommendation.title: Accept Prompt-Stable Room Events
recommendation.body: Land the linked candidate after confirming that ambient room events should use the safe non-owner owner-only inventory and separated prompt-facing delivery mode.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the visible-reply and ambient-room policy baseline from the merged group visible-reply work.
